gpu.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (0x00001F11) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

ktx2.note: KTX-Software 4.4.2 via gltf-transform 4.5.1 (etc1s defaults; uastc --level 2 --rdo --zstd 18 on the shell only). KTX2Loader transcodes to the best format the GPU offers; gpuBytes are the uploaded mip chains (RGBA8 with mips for WebP). diffVsWebp is the mean absolute 8-bit difference against the WebP render of the same view.

anchors.space: glTF, Y up, metres; three.js PerspectiveCamera vertical fov in degrees

renderInfo.note: renderer.info.render after one frame at the overview

frameRate.note: Capped = Chromium default frame pacing (60 Hz). Uncapped = --disable-gpu-vsync --disable-frame-rate-limit: headroom, not what a user sees. Throttled = CDP Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate 4 on the capped browser: CPU only, the GPU is still the RTX 2060, so it is a rough proxy and not a mid-range Android.

timeToFirstFrame.note: From navigation start to the first rendered frame of the room (GLB fetched from localhost, meshopt decoded, textures decoded and uploaded). Localhost: no network time.

gpuTextureMemory.note: WebP/JPEG/PNG decode to RGBA8 on the GPU: about 22.4 MB per 2048 texture with mips, 89.5 MB per 4096. KTX2 figures are estimates from block sizes (ETC1S -> BC1/ETC2 at 0.5 B/px opaque, 1 B/px with alpha; UASTC -> BC7/ASTC 4x4 at 1 B/px); not measured, KTX-Software was not approved.

4_boardTextContrast.rule: --ink on --surface at 92% over the blurred anchor view, every pixel under the card

bakeFidelityVsCycles.note: Cycles reference includes glossy reflections and full-res geometry; the bake is diffuse only, so some difference is expected

budgets.note: no device; 4x CPU-throttled desktop proxy: 60 fps overview, 60 fps travel

budgets.budget: Scene JS chunk / route shell JS
budgets.note: not measured: the harness is plain three.js outside the app, not the R3F bundle

itemSizeProbe.note: item A over budget: the same GLB with a lower WebP quality or a 768 texture

unproven: A mid-range Android: not measured. The 4x CPU throttle leaves the RTX 2060 in place; mobile GPU fill rate, thermal throttling, and texture upload on a phone are untested.
KTX2 / Basis: KTX-Software was not approved, so no KTX2 files, transcoder cost (245 KB wasm) or ETC1S banding were measured; the GPU-memory gain is an estimate from block sizes.
Real art: a stand-in from CC0 assets. The design team's room will differ in triangle count, texel density and how many atlases it needs.
React Three Fiber and the app bundle: the harness is plain three.js outside Next.js, so the scene JS budgets (D-10) are untouched.
Network: assets came from localhost. First-view bytes are real; time to first frame excludes download time (5 MB at 20 Mbit/s adds about 2 s).
Acceptance criteria 1 (hotspot names and menu at 4.5:1, no hidden anchor objects) and the boards themselves: no hotspots, menu or real boards exist yet.
